name: image2design
description: 把截图、设计稿或 UI 参考图复刻为高保真响应式设计实现，并通过 Image Gen 生成复杂位图资产、用截图 diff 校准。

interface.shortDescription: 从参考图生成高保真响应式设计实现
interface.longDescription: 安装后可使用 $image2design，把截图、设计稿、海报或 UI mockup 复刻为高保真响应式前端/设计稿。复杂徽章、贴纸、纹理和图标会优先通过 $imagegen 生成项目内位图资产，并用浏览器截图、visual_diff 指标和叠图按比例、间距、颜色、字体、阴影和资产观感迭代校准。
defaultPrompt: Use $image2design to recreate this screenshot as a high-fidelity responsive design implementation.
Use $image2design to generate bitmap assets for complex badges or illustrations, then calibrate the page with screenshot diff.
Use $image2design to convert this UI mockup into responsive HTML/CSS and verify it at the reference and non-reference viewports.
